Name: Em's Trinkets and Companions
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Step into battle with a new look for the trinkets and companions!
Including all six trinkets and multiple choices for the frog, fairy and parrot
Each trinket and companion is included by default and can be disabled individually
Available for Content Patcher, compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/q7wsD3jw/Frog-Config.png[/img]

Fairy box: There are four options to choose from. [color=#e69138]Pink[/color], [color=#e69138]flowers[/color], [color=#e69138]wood[/color] or [color=#e69138]shell[/color]
Fairies: Keep them as small [color=#e69138]fairies[/color], or turn them into [color=#e69138]butterflies[/color][color=#efefef], a[/color]s well as a [color=#e69138]bee[/color]
Frog: The [color=#efefef]frog[/color] has seven color options or can be changed into a [color=#e69138]mouse[/color]. When choosing the mouse option, the Frog Egg trinket becomes a Mouse Cheese trinket
Parrot: The parrot has five color options to choose from. [color=#e69138]Red[/color], [color=#e69138]green[/color], [color=#e69138]white[/color][color=#efefef],[/color][color=#e69138]yellow[/color] or [color=#e69138]blue[/color]

To change the default into a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the mod folder
Replace the name between the "[color=#e69138]brackets[/color]" with the name of the type you like
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Trinket Companions"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/yNjmpZvT/Mouse-Trinket.png[/img]

When you change the frog to a mouse, the frog trinket changes from a frog egg to mouse cheese
If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] but already have the frog egg obtained, the image changes, but the name remains "Frog egg"
This changes into "Mouse Cheese" after restarting the game once and isn't a mistake, just the game trying to load its known data
